summary: A standalone benchmark for multi-task DECOMPOSITION, workflow-pattern ORCHESTRATION, and lane ARBITRATION — the capabilities RealBio's routing/param tasks do not cover. Kept separate from RealBio (not folded into its MANIFEST) so RealBio's published-baseline weighting is untouched. Composes existing component datasets with their existing scorers; no data is duplicated.

discipline.leakage_firewall: decomposition is scored ONLY on decomposition_real (out-of-generator). decomposition_v2 is same-generator and was RETRACTED (reported 0.73 vs real ~0.016) — it is EXCLUDED from this suite and must never be scored here.
discipline.harness_split: report BARE (model-only) vs +HARNESS (retrieval/catalog-assisted) for every component, as RealBio does, so the harness dividend is visible.
discipline.execution_grounding: composer_orchestration credit requires the resolved DAG to be structurally executable (type-handoffs satisfied), not merely proposed.

benchmarks.name: decomposition_real
benchmarks.task: Given a multi-step research request, decompose it into the correct set of sub-tasks (nodes) and their dependencies (edges). OUT-OF-GENERATOR held-out — the honest transfer test.

benchmarks.name: composer_orchestration
benchmarks.task: Resolve a multi-stage pipeline into an executable DAG: pick the workflow per stage AND wire outputs→inputs via semantic type-handoff (topological waves). Credit requires the handoffs to type-satisfy (executable), not just be proposed.
benchmarks.scorer: evaluation/scorers/chain_scorer.py score_chain (coverage + LCS order + gate adherence) + decomposed_dag type_satisfies resolution
benchmarks.note: semantic type-handoff fix this session lifted DAG fire 4.4%→38.2%; cross-ecosystem reps (counts_matrix vs ExpressionSet) remain a representation gap.

benchmarks.name: reverse_decomp
benchmarks.task: Inverse orchestration: given an executed plan / sub-task set, recover the originating research intent (capability grounding).

benchmarks.name: lane_arbitration
benchmarks.task: Given a request that plausibly fits multiple execution lanes (Nextflow/Galaxy/Bioconductor/run_code), arbitrate to the correct lane (dense-cosine resonance, not keyword).

comparators.note: Score the SAME items for every system, like RealBio. Rows to populate:
systems: frontier LLMs bare + harness (Opus-5.5, DeepSeek V4-pro, GLM-5.3, Qwen small)
Biomni (A1 scaffold) — already a RealBio comparator; its planner decomposes, so it is a natural decomposition/orchestration baseline
TxAgent+ToolUniverse — open therapeutics planner (drug-dev-relevant multi-tool orchestration)
